findings.title: The F-2 fix moved the frozen set onto the receipt but no digest reader consumes it: a still-frozen message vanishes from the daily digest after 24h and the one-line OK is sent
findings.file: scripts/brain/client_state_gmail.py:413-416 (comment claim), scripts/brain/client_state_digest.py:240-351 (gmail_section reads receipt only for truncation/health/gap)
findings.evidence: grep for extraction_failures/frozen in client_state_digest.py: no match. Probe A: the digest 1 minute after the freeze carries the frozen line (from the row); 2 days later, with the message still frozen and receipt.extraction_failures still listing it, gmail_section returns 'Client state (Gmail) OK - 0 changes in 24h, invariants OK, poller last success ...'. So the only human cue for an unfiled message that will never be retried automatically is shown exactly once; the code comment says the receipt is what lets the digest surface the frozen set, which it does not. FR-009 exists so 'an implausible commitment is seen within a day' and 'a silent watcher is indistinguishable from a dead one'; a frozen-but-unfiled message after day 1 is exactly a silent state. Introduced by the fix's design (the receipt entry with frozen: true is new and unread).
findings.spec_ref: FR-009 (daily digest lists what needs a human; one-line OK only when nothing to report), FR-001 (frozen identity 'says so in the digest' - ledger ruling G2r3-7)
findings.recommended_fix: In client_state_digest.gmail_section, read receipt.get('extraction_failures', []) and append one line per entry ('- extraction frozen - manual re-run: <source_ref> (<last_error>) - client_state_gmail.py --retry-frozen'), so the OK line cannot collapse while any identity is frozen; dedupe against the row-derived line for the day of the freeze; pin with a test asserting the line persists on a later day and the OK line does not fire. Alternatively delete the comment claim and record the once-only cue as a ruling.

findings.title: The freeze branch persists an UNDELIVERED 'escalated' outcome (no _demote_undelivered_escalations), so a multi-party message with an ambiguous counterparty and a frozen fileable sibling never escalates - and escalated_for() then treats it as delivered forever
findings.file: scripts/brain/client_state_gmail.py:448-470 (freeze branch appends `resolutions` unchanged); :355-360 (_demote_undelivered_escalations exists but is not called here); observation_ledger.py:221-239 (escalated_for reads a persisted 'escalated' as proof of delivery)
findings.evidence: Probe H: sender marcos@acme.org (page-domain acme) + cc amb@acme.org (CRM company Alloy -> ambiguous:alloi|acme), two rejected outputs: run1 exit 0, escalated=1, send-telegram calls 0, row resolutions [('acme','partial'), ('','escalated')]; run2 (skip path) 0 sends. Because the persisted outcome is 'escalated' with delivered=False, esc_state['already'] is True on every later run, including after --retry-frozen succeeds - Josh is never paged about the ambiguity. Pre-existing in LIVE-1's freeze branch (not introduced by the fix), but the F-2 skip path now guarantees no later sweep re-enters the branch, so I report it here rather than let it ride. Rare (needs both conditions on one message) and no data is corrupted, hence Important.
findings.spec_ref: FR-003 (escalate EXACTLY ONCE - and at least once; 'Routing, not approval'), G-ESC-3 invariant ('an escalated outcome is only ever persisted AFTER a successful send')
findings.recommended_fix: Call _demote_undelivered_escalations() before appending the frozen row (and the budget row at :486-499 for the same reason), so the ambiguity is re-evaluated and sent by the next run that gets past extraction; or send the escalation before extraction for the escalated subset (it does not depend on the extraction). Pin with a test: ambiguous + frozen -> send-telegram exactly once across sweeps.

summary: F-1 and F-2 are fixed and re-verified on the fixed tree by nine probes (transport rc!=0 and timeout now exit 3 with the cause on the receipt and no attempt consumed; a frozen message writes nothing, enumerates nothing and spends nothing on later sweeps; new digest / widened slugs still proceed; --retry-frozen works; both new mutation seds bite). F-3 confirmed-code-kept against the committed goal amendment (1fc94d2a); F-4 carried as an activate-goal watch item with its trigger. Two new Important findings from the corrections: F-5 the receipt's frozen list has no digest reader, so a still-frozen message drops out of the digest after 24h and the OK line fires; F-6 the freeze branch persists an undelivered 'escalated' outcome, so an ambiguous counterparty on a frozen message is never paged (pre-existing LIVE-1 branch, now made permanent by the skip path). Regenerated G4 evidence at 2c3ab594 is consistent with the fixed code and the write boundary; floor.txt/gate-invocations not yet in that dir.
